title: Design: Convert to No Charge sits in the work order three-dots menu
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new billable work order for the regular customer, not invoiced, with no deposit, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow2-01-01-convert-to-no-charge.png, iwo-happy-21-21-or-convert-a-billable-work-order.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Click the three-dots menu in the header.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • "Convert to No Charge" is offered next to Add Work Order Fee / Discount.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R5: “On a billable work order on a regular customer, the three-dots menu offers "Convert to No Charge" (next to Add Work Order Fee / Discount) until the work order is invoiced.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
